items.source: Whether the given method return type is supported by this handler.
items.translation: 给定方法返回类型是否由该处理器支持。

items.source: Header containing a DataBufferFactory for use in return value handling.
items.translation: 包含用于返回值处理的 DataBufferFactory 的 Header。

items.source: returnType - the type of the return value. This type must have previously been passed to supportsReturnType(MethodParameter) and it must have returned true.
items.translation: returnType - 返回值的类型。此类型必须先前已传递给supportsReturnType(MethodParameter)，并且它必须返回true。

items.source: Handle the return value from the invocation of an annotated Message handling method.
items.translation: 处理对带有注解的Message处理方法的调用返回值。

items.source: true if this handler supports the supplied return type; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此处理器支持提供的返回类型；否则为 false。

items.source: returnType - the method return type to check
items.translation: returnType - 要检查的方法返回类型

items.source: returnValue - the value returned from the handler method
items.translation: returnValue - 从处理程序方法返回的值

items.source: Mono<Void> to indicate when handling is complete.
